title: SSX Out of Bounds
statusNote: Logos, title, profile name, rider choice, main menu and options work; a Single Event race on Snow Jam loads and runs in 3D with the other riders, steering, jumping, falls and the pause menu. The race view has black bars above and below it.
notes: On the first start the game asks for a profile name (the digit keys type letters, the left soft key accepts) and a favourite rider.
In menus 5 selects and 7 goes back. In a race, tricks fill the boost meter and 5 spends it; after a fall, tap 5 to recover.
The keys can be changed in the game under Options > Key Mapping.

Multiplayer in the main menu (Host or Join, up to four players): the joining player picks the host from the list, the host accepts and presses Connect. The host picks a rider, then the joining player, then the host picks the peak and the track, and the race starts for both. N-Gage Arena was Nokia's online service and cannot work.

multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one chooses Host and accepts the warning that the Bluetooth name will change, the other Join and the host in the list; the host accepts and presses Connect, each picks a rider, the host the track. A race ran on both screens with both riders in view; a pause is shown to the other player, and when one gives up the other is told. Tried with the original game, two players.

controls.source: The game's Options > Key Mapping screen (its defaults) and the key help shown before a race. Steering, the pause menu on the right soft key and the keys used in the menus and the name entry were observed in play.

actions.5: Boost; grab 5; recover after a fall; select in menus

notes: Keyboard: arrows steer, Space or Z jumps (7), Enter or X boosts and selects (5), A and D punch (4 and 6), Escape pauses; the grabs stay on the digit row. Gamepad: A or X is 5, B or Y is 7, the shoulder buttons punch (4 and 6), the triggers are grabs 9 and 10, the right stick gives grabs 1 (left), 3 (right), 2 (up) and 8 (down), Start pauses, Back is the left soft key and pressing the left stick is 0 (respawn).

enhance.note: Riders, course, rails, trees and rocks are redrawn. Not exact yet: a texture whose light changes across a polygon gets one light level per polygon, scenery the game fades in with a checker pattern is drawn half transparent, and dithered snow shading shows as bands at the larger sizes.
